text: I think you'll enjoy this Walnut Streusel Coffee Cake recipe, given your fondness for quick-breads and sweet treats. The use of brown sugar and walnuts provides a nice depth of flavor, and the streusel topping adds a delightful crunch. While it does contain some dairy, the recipe is relatively quick to make and doesn't appear to be overly rich or heavy, which aligns with your observed pattern of preferring lighter eating options.
